pspNames.description: PodSecurityPolicy names which cert-manager is allowed to use

enableGatewayAPIListenerSet.description: Enable reconciliation of Gateway API ListenerSet resources. This setting only enables the controller logic path for ListenerSet support, and is effective only when enableGatewayAPI is true and the feature gate ListenerSets is enabled.

feature_gates.description: Feature toggles for experimental features - toggle with true/false, if null the controller assumes the toggle's default

deploymentMode.description: detail configuration for cer-manager related deployments

resources.description: Configure CPU and memory requests/limits for the container

limits.description: Define the resources limits to overwrite the default values

requests.description: User input the resources requests to overwrite the default values

private_key.description: The issuer's private key configuration - see https://cert-manager.io/docs/reference/api-docs/#cert-manager.io/v1.CertificatePrivateKey

kubernetes_distribution.description: Optional: Kubernetes platform distribution that this package is being installed on. Accepted values: ['','openshift']

kubernetes_version.description: Optional: Kubernetes platform version that this package is being installed on. Accepted format: ['x.x.x']

namespace.description: cert-manager's namespace - also used as its cluster resource namespace https://cert-manager.io/docs/configuration/#cluster-resource-namespace

defaultLimits.description: User can input the defaultLimits values to overwrite the default

defaultRequests.description: User can input the defaultRequests values to overwrite the default

priorityClassName.description: The user defined priorityClass name of pod
